question.text: Receivable dividends declared but not yet received are treated as:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the Cat III AIF asset list, dividends declared but not yet received are assets for the fund (and eventually income). The Trap: Liabilities and off-balance-sheet treatments misclassify these receivables; dividends declared by the fund but not yet paid would instead sit on the liabilities side. Note: Accrual treatment aligns with the fund's standard accounting framework.
